description: Business ontology (semantic layer) over the governed Fabric Lakehouse. Maps FinOps business concepts to physical Lakehouse tables and defines the relationships that connect pricing, token usage, organization, governance, and the 12 ML outputs so questions can be answered against meaning rather than raw tables.

classes.label: Cloud / Model Provider
classes.description: A cloud or model provider that serves AI models (AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI Direct, Anthropic Claude).

classes.label: Model Family
classes.description: A family of related models (e.g. GPT-5, Claude Opus, Gemini 2.5).

classes.label: Model
classes.description: A specific model + version that consumes tokens and is priced.

classes.label: Price Point
classes.description: An effective-dated token price (market and negotiated, input/output/cached per million tokens) for a model. Slowly-changing (SCD-2) - the source of truth for costing.

classes.label: Token Usage Event
classes.description: The Gold fact: governed token consumption with input/output/cached tokens, latency, and market/negotiated/actual cost, attributed to the full org hierarchy.

classes.label: User / Persona
classes.description: A hashed user assigned to a behavioural persona and the org hierarchy.

classes.label: Team
classes.description: An engineering/business team that consumes AI.

classes.label: Department
classes.description: A department in the org hierarchy.

classes.label: Business Unit
classes.description: A business unit aggregating departments.

classes.label: Cost Center
classes.description: The financial cost center used for chargeback.

classes.label: Project
classes.description: A funded project with budget and quota.

classes.label: Application
classes.description: An application/agent that issues model requests.

classes.label: Environment
classes.description: Deployment environment (dev/test/prod).

classes.label: Task Type
classes.description: The kind of work the tokens performed (summarization, code_generation, etc.).

classes.label: Budget Plan
classes.description: A per-project monthly budget and approved TPM/RPM.

classes.label: Quota Policy
classes.description: Current per-project, per-provider TPM/RPM quota and minimum headroom.

classes.label: Model Benchmark
classes.description: Quality and cost benchmark per model and task type; production approval.

classes.label: Business Outcome
classes.description: Outcomes produced by AI work (tickets resolved, PRs merged, hours saved) with estimated business value.

classes.label: Capacity Metric
classes.description: Infrastructure capacity signal (gateway RPS, regional model capacity) vs limit.

classes.label: Release Event
classes.description: A planned release that changes expected usage for a project.

classes.label: ML Insight
classes.description: Abstract superclass of the 12 PySpark ML outputs: a scored signal for an entity with risk/probability/predicted cost/estimated savings and a recommendation. Unified in ml.ml_insight_fact.

classes.label: Anomaly
classes.description: A detected consumption anomaly.

classes.label: Budget Overrun Risk
classes.description: A predicted budget overrun for a project.

classes.label: Model Optimization
classes.description: A zero-quality-loss model downgrade opportunity with savings.

classes.label: Quota Recommendation
classes.description: A recommended TPM/RPM adjustment to avoid throttling.

classes.label: Prompt Quality Score
classes.description: Prompt bloat / reducible-token score for an app.

classes.label: Recommended Action
classes.description: A concrete, reviewable FinOps action derived from ML insights (model switch, rate/token-limit change, reallocation, throttle guardrail, prompt trim, chargeback) - the closed feedback loop surfaced by the Action Center API.

classes.label: ML Model Run
classes.description: A training/inference notebook run that produced ML outputs (lineage + watermark).

relationships.label: pricedBy
relationships.via: source_code, model_name, model_version, usage_date in [effective_from, effective_to)
